instrumentation: A declared synchronous HTML fixture loads a pinned read-only observer before app scripts. It wraps Storage/IndexedDB calls without changing native arguments/results, retains a bounded per-document buffer, and reports to a same-origin collector independent of Playwright. A separate task-owned preview serves the verified emitted inventory with fixture credentials and public,max-age=0,must-revalidate headers. No Playwright routing is installed. The declared diagnostic HTML fixture and bounded event collector are served by this test-only server.

observationLimit: Saved local/session values must be identical. Mutation assertions cover observed top-document events and no new observed startup mutation signatures; they do not prove equal write volume, persisted IndexedDB values, or absence of an undelivered old-document tail after detachment. Restored startup must reconcile its complete retained buffer. Native inspector-only diagnostics during the detached interval are not claimed.
limitations: The preview serves the verified emitted inventory after verifying its captured source identity against the current checkout. The local HTML access fixture and additional hashed synchronous observation script tag are declared. This is not offline HTML integrity proof; service workers are not blocked or unregistered.
Actual urgent discard is requested only for the exact owned game tab through chrome://discards UI; no user browser, extension, crash, synthetic wasDiscarded override, or page.reload fallback is used.
Every accepted case requires the native UI to report discarded, a new document identity, and native document.wasDiscarded=true after tab activation.
Fresh profiles cover ordinary entry plus watching/practice in each selected mode; existing saved-flight checkpoint tests remain complementary.
Storage API observers preserve native return values; managed media asset-cache writes are recorded separately from player persistence, following the existing restoration helper.

Resource assertions cover no restored demo surface/owned scene and absence of exactly observed dedicated-worker native target IDs after confirmed discard. They do not measure browser-internal GPU/process memory.

The canonical full runtime scope excludes tests, coverage reports, documentation, binary assets and ignored files. The canonical scripts/authoring build-input scope uses the same file selection rules and is independently bound before/after; relevant helpers, this probe, and its ignored evidence helper are also pinned. This is not a hash of every repository file.
The before/after fingerprints detect changes at those boundaries, not transient edits reverted during the run. The parent must keep the declared source freeze and exclusive browser slot held.
Invocation requires an exact newly frozen HEAD/runtime; this preparation script itself grants no browser or discard credit until all strict checks complete.
